newsitem.title: USA: U.S.June same-store sales rise 2.7 pct - TeleCheck.
newsitem.headline: U.S.June same-store sales rise 2.7 pct - TeleCheck.

text.p: June same-store retail spending rose 2.7 percent over the same period last year, according to data compiled by TeleCheck Services Inc.
June same-store sales growth would have been higher, except for a calendar fluctuation that gave this June one less Saturday than last, TeleCheck said in a release.
Warmer weather in June, following a cooler-than-normal spring, also may have helped boost spending for seasonal merchandise.

TeleCheck, a check-acceptance company, said the Mid-Atlantic led the nation with a 3.6 percent gain, while the the Northeast rose 2.7 percent, the Midwest gained 2.6 percent and the Southeast and West had 1.7 percent gains.

The TeleCheck Retail Index is based on a year-over-year, same-store comparison of the dollar volume of checks written by consumers at more than 27,000 of TeleCheck's 167,000 subscribing locations. Figures are not adjusted for inflation.
TeleCheck is a unit of First Data Corp.
